GATE_CONTROLS.rule: before launch every gate and in-image check runs WHOLE in its real runtime against a known-good target that must PASS (positive control) and a known-bad target that must FAIL (null control); a gate without both controls passing does not go on the box. working/scripts/p3_gate_controls.py runs them on the box (the box's ~/.venv Python for the chain gates; the engine's Python inside the container for the in-image check; each image's own interpreter for the bare microbenchmark) and writes gate_controls.json; p3_master.sh REFUSES to start unless it says all_pass

controls.G_memstat: positive P2's committed p2a_rr_a (rows) -> pass; null an empty memstat.jsonl -> fail
controls.G_mandate (docs): positive P2's p2a_rr_a -> clean; null the same leg marked violating -> violation
controls.G_mandate (video): positive P2's p2b_rr_base_a -> clean; null a directory holding MANDATE_VIOLATION.json -> violation
controls.G_alone: positive no container -> pass; null one created container -> fail
controls.G_health_A: positive P2's p2a_rr_b / p2a_li_b standing in as the P3 legs against the committed p2a_rr_a/b -> fired; null one RR chunk hash altered -> not fired; null the LlamaIndex sampler empty -> not fired
controls.G_smoke_C: positive vars=2 10% faster with identical chunks -> fires vars=2; null all shapes equal -> none; null vars=2 faster but one chunk list differs -> none (correctness first)
controls.G_node_D: positive counters with text -> pass; null P1's failure (text 0) -> fail
controls.G_smoke_D: positive HYBRID faster than Tika's spread, no coverage loss -> fires hybrid; null both variants inside Tika's spread -> none
controls.G_build_D in-image check: positive rr:p2-pdfium (pypdfium2 complete) under the landed encoding-fixed check -> ok true, rc 0; null rr:p1-pdfium (pypdfium2_cfg missing) -> ok false, rc 1
controls.P3-B one-model check: each image's own interpreter: positive one model -> rc 0; null --null-two-models -> rc 3 (the mandate refusal)

P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.hypothesis: with the P1-B wrapper fix, one RocketRide token reaches at least 0.85 of LlamaIndex's 24-worker docs/s on the FULL corpus
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.evidence: cross-session: rr:p1-tikafix 5.34 docs/s (P1-B) vs LlamaIndex 5.10 (Stage 4); P2-A's 384 smoke gave 0.826, but that slice holds none of the eleven pathological PDFs (P1-B +12.6% on the slice vs +128% full) and its span is drain-dominated (both arms ~13 of 32 cores)
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.health_smoke: Ansh's ruling: for this experiment the smoke is a HEALTH gate, not a performance proxy. One 384 leg each: p3a_rr_h (rr:p1-tikafix, ONE token, C=32, stamped) and p3a_li_h (LlamaIndex 24 workers, C=32)
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.G_health_A: FIRES iff (i) both legs are verdict OK or DEGRADED with every row recorded; (ii) D0 is clean on both; (iii) the memory sampler is non-empty on both; (iv) the RR leg's chunk lists equal P2-A's COMMITTED rr:p1-tikafix legs (p2a_rr_a AND p2a_rr_b) on every shared ok document
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.full: only if G_health_A fired: one 9,975 run each, same arms, this session, RR first: p3a_rr_full (texts captured; the fixed-Tika full comparator for P3-C and P3-D) and p3a_li_full
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.report: span docs/s, the excluded-straggler view, CPU-s/doc, utilisation, idle cores, idle spin, sampled memory peak, lost documents, the empty-document set difference both ways
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.ratio_rule: r = RR span docs/s / LI span docs/s, n = 1 per arm, stated plainly. LlamaIndex's smoke-scale replicate spread (8.19%, P2-A) bounds how much of it is readable: SUPPORTED iff r >= 0.85 x 1.0819 = 0.9196 (readably at or above the bar); NOT SUPPORTED iff r < 0.85 x (1 - 0.0819) = 0.7804 (readably below); otherwise the ratio is AT THE BAR WITHIN LlamaIndex's REPLICATE SPREAD and the hypothesis is UNREADABLE at n = 1 — the report says so
P3_A_docs_full_scale_headline.if_not_fired: the full runs are NOT RUN and the report names the failed health condition

P3_B_video_discriminator.approval: approved by Ansh as within the single-instance mandate
P3_B_video_discriminator.hypothesis: RocketRide's slower forward pass is caused by the engine process environment, not by the model or its libraries
P3_B_video_discriminator.evidence: P2-B: removing the debugger and setting MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 closed only 0.25 of the gap; post-hoc, CPU per frame is about equal once the idle burn is removed but RR's forward runs on fewer cores at once; torch, rfdetr and model construction are identical (P0 V2) and pool and affinity read-backs are identical (P1-A)
P3_B_video_discriminator.ruled_out_beforehand: per-frame lock hand-off leaving caller pools cold: P0 measured K=1 (one caller) at 2.39 f/s, no faster than K=16
P3_B_video_discriminator.frames: ONE fixed set: the first 3 measured rows of the AMI manifest, extracted once with li:video's imageio-ffmpeg binary and the engine-mirror argv (fps=1/15, -fps_mode passthrough, -vcodec png; byte-identical to the engine's frame grabber per probe_frame_parity 2026-08-27) -> p3b_frames_manifest.json (sha256 per frame; the frames stay outside the repository). Cells (a) and (b) hash every frame they load and must match it; cell (c) runs the same 3 videos through the engine's own frame grabber (identity by construction; its frame count must equal the manifest's)

(1)_inspection.what: READ-ONLY: from /proc/<pid>/maps of each detector process, every loaded OpenMP, BLAS or threading runtime (libgomp, libiomp5, libomp, libmkl*, libopenblas*, libblas, libcblas, libflexiblas, liblapack, libtbb*) with paths, plus the torch (libtorch*, libc10*) and numpy (_multiarray_umath) library identities. RR: the engine task process in the (c) legs, at warm-up end (driver P1_SYNC_DIR hook, before the measured window). LlamaIndex: its worker process in one service leg p3b_d_1 (li:video, one instance, K=1, the same 3 videos, stamped) — that leg exists for the inspection; its figures are context. The bare cells read their own /proc/self/maps
(1)_inspection.hypothesis: the RR engine process loads a second OpenMP or BLAS runtime that LlamaIndex's does not
(1)_inspection.reading: SUPPORTED iff the RR task process maps two or more distinct OpenMP runtime files (libgomp* / libiomp5* / libomp* by path), OR maps an OpenMP, BLAS or TBB runtime family that LlamaIndex's detector process does not; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED. Paths are reported either way

cells.a: rr:patched-video's embedded Python (/opt/rocketride/engine/engine) running working/video/p3b/p3b_bench.py as a bare script outside the engine; RFDETRBase() constructed with the image's weights directory as cwd (/opt/rocketride/engine/cache/models/rfdetr), as detection.py RFDetrLoader.load does
cells.b: li:video's Python running the same script; RFDETRBase() with /opt/rfdetr-cache as cwd
cells.c: inside the RR engine task process: rr:patched-video, one token, the P1 stamped detect copy (forward pre/post hooks on the same root module), K=1 (one video in flight) on the same 3 videos, P0_ONTOKEN D0

(2)_bare_microbenchmark.common: T=4 (six thread variables = 4, set by docker run -e; torch threads read back in-process); ONE caller thread in (a)/(b) (the main thread); predict(image, threshold=0.3); the bare cells run a 10-frame warm-up pre-pass, then measure EVERY frame of the set; the engine cell's warm-up runs on the manifest's disjoint warm rows; --network none on the bare cells
(2)_bare_microbenchmark.order: ABAB two runs each: p3b_a_1 p3b_b_1 p3b_c_1 p3b_a_2 p3b_b_2 p3b_c_2, then p3b_d_1 (the LlamaIndex inspection leg)
(2)_bare_microbenchmark.mandate: each cell runs ALONE (G_alone before every bare cell: no container exists); exactly one model instance exists at any moment (the bare script counts its model's root-class instances and exits 3 on any count but 1); a standalone script, never a pipeline or a pool
(2)_bare_microbenchmark.metrics: per leg: F = mean forward wall per measured frame (a/b: every frame of the set; c: the last N frame stamps by wall time, N = the records' frame count); cores busy during the forward = sum process CPU across forwards / sum forward wall; caller on-CPU share = sum calling-thread CPU / sum forward wall. Per cell: the mean of its two legs and its replicate spread
(2)_bare_microbenchmark.approx_rule: x ~= y iff |F_x / F_y - 1| <= max(spread_x, spread_y) (the larger of the two cells' replicate spreads, as instructed); x < y iff F_x / F_y - 1 < -max(spread_x, spread_y); the carried 0.82% floor is reported beside each comparison

reading.a ~= b < c: the engine process environment owns the gap (a < c and b < c)
reading.a ~= c > b: the interpreter or runtime build owns it (a > b and c > b)
reading.a ~= b ~= c: the gap lives in pipeline-level scheduling (all three pairs ~=)
reading.otherwise: no pre-registered reading matches; the three pairwise relations and the cores-in-forward figures are reported

P3_C_embedding_thread_shape.scope: CONFIG/THREADING only, no patch; cross-document batching is a node patch and is NOT built in P3 (P3-E drafts its design)
P3_C_embedding_thread_shape.hypothesis: 32 concurrent single-threaded embedding passes are not the best shape for the stage that is now ~92% of RR document time
P3_C_embedding_thread_shape.evidence: P1-B stage shares (embed ~0.92); P2-D embedding trace: no cross-document batching, up to 32 single-threaded passes, no model lock; S5-E: unset threads (16) measured -13.7% against =1, so an optimum may lie between
P3_C_embedding_thread_shape.smoke: the 384 slice, rr:p1-tikafix, ONE token, C=32, stamped, the six thread variables in {1, 2, 4} (read back in-process: torch threads must equal the declared value — a mismatch is a D0 violation), ABAB two runs each: p3c_t1_a p3c_t2_a p3c_t4_a p3c_t1_b p3c_t2_b p3c_t4_b; every leg captures its chunk embedding vectors (P3_VEC_DUMP; S3 only)
P3_C_embedding_thread_shape.correctness: FIRST: a shape counts only if its text chunks (chunk_sha256 lists) equal vars=1's on every shared ok document — both of its runs against both vars=1 runs — and it loses no document vars=1 answered. Reported beside, never gating: the embedding vectors' maximum absolute delta against vars=1 (same-letter pair) per shape, and vars=1 run a vs run b as the determinism reference, since thread count can shift numerics

SMOKE_GATE_P3_C.rule: a shape FIRES iff it passes correctness AND mean(shape span docs/s) / mean(vars=1) - 1 > max(0.82%, spread(vars=1), spread(shape)); the WINNER is the fired shape with the largest gain
SMOKE_GATE_P3_C.threshold: max(0.82%, the two within-session replicate spreads)

P3_C_embedding_thread_shape.full: only if a shape fired: one 9,975 run of the winner (p3c_t<W>_full), compared with P3-A's RR full leg (vars=1); if that leg does not exist, a vars=1 full leg p3c_t1_full runs first; one run each, readable iff |delta| > 0.82%
